novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanistic/measurement relationship rather than merely a new setting: it asks whether “belief, knowledge, and fact are encoded as three related but distinguishable axes” and specifically predicts that “knowledge” is the conjunction of belief and truth. The closest prior work is “Belief in the Machine: Investigating Epistemological Blind Spots of Language Models” (KaBLE), which studies the belief–knowledge–fact distinction behaviorally, alongside Marks and Tegmark’s “The Geometry of Truth” and Li et al.’s ITI work on truth directions; searches used “LLM belief knowledge fact representation geometry,” “knowledge belief truth activation space,” “factive knowledge mechanistic interpretability,” and “LLM truth direction conjunction.” The step from those works to this claim is a natural extension with a non-trivial new relational hypothesis, not a direct transfer, but the proposed probes, subspaces, and causal steering are standard methods and the AND/JTB structure is a fairly direct operationalization of the existing behavioral distinction, so this fits the 5–6 band rather than 7–8.
